plugins.description: Product Consciousness Framework for AI agents. Supports software, general, and agentic project types. Includes governing_principles as the universal anchor of the organizational governance chain (company_blueprint → ecosystem rules → local rules → logbooks), 4 defense layers (inline rules + banner + post-impl audit + integrity audit), adversarial subagents (orthogonality reviewer + integrity reviewer + verifier pattern A→B), background metacognition, and multi-session continuity. Complete product lifecycle from feasibility analysis (Monte Carlo / Bayesian) to resolution.
